description: Read on-chain balances for a sub-account's child Safe. Pass currency (USDC / EURC / CHFAU / CADD / MXNB) to filter to a single token; omit to get every enabled token. Balances are returned as raw bigint strings — 6 decimals for USDC/EURC/CHFAU/MXNB, 18 for CADD.

currency.description: Filter to a single token. Omit for all enabled currencies.

name: get_sub_account_balance
